summary: Replaced the detached pnpm-based Windows launcher with a hidden wscript.exe/.cmd runner so no console window appears, and folded the agent-server boot into the managed runner to avoid a second child process. After fixing a Vite binary path resolution error and tightening TypeScript import syntax, both ports 5173 and 8787 listen and HTTP 200 was returned from localhost:5173.
decisions: Windows detached launcher now uses wscript.exe + a generated .cmd file with windowsHide instead of a detached pnpm process, because pnpm trees were attaching a conhost console window.
The agent server is imported in-process by the runner instead of being spawned as a separate child process, to simplify the Windows process tree and keep it fully detached.
Use join(dirname(requireFromApp.resolve('vite/package.json')), 'bin', 'vite.js') to locate the Vite CLI, instead of relying on requireFromApp.resolve('vite/bin/vite.js').
errors: Dev server failed to start: an initial edit attempt did not match the file (whitespace mismatch); retried successfully.
TypeScript compile failed with TS2835 because the new import of the agent server omitted the .ts extension; fixed by writing the explicit .ts extension and passing --allowImportingTsExtensions.

Server still exited during startup because the runner attempted to resolve 'vite/bin/vite.js' directly, which failed package-exports resolution; fixed by resolving 'vite/package.json' and joining bin/vite.js.
Earlier curl checks returned HTTP 000 / exit 7 because no listener was up while iterating on the launcher; the final run returned HTTP 200.
